description:
Cast an instant or sorcery spell, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, targeting the spell.
Activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Twincast, with the copy targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the copy of Twincast, copying Twincast, targeting the original Twincast.
Repeat step 4.
